plan.analysis: All three classes still fail on their smallest tertile (inclusion low-tertile recall 0.185, patches 0.478, scratches 0.377); missed medians (33.6/52.7/43.6 px) are ~0.4-0.6x the train medians. Round 1's prefer_small + 0.3/0.4 scale floors likely produced sub-learnable micro-pastes, so I raise the floor to 0.5 and use uniform weighting over sources that natively resemble the misses: short faint thin streaks (inclusion), small soft dark blobs (patches), thin bright vertical lines (scratches, incl. the high-contrast ones the model misses). Inclusion is worst (recall 0.285, 130 misses) so it gets the largest share; patches/scratches keep enough volume to avoid starving the shared detector.
plan.rationale: Shift from round 1: drop the 0.3/0.4 micro-scale floors (unlearnable pastes) and prefer_small, and instead paste appearance-matched sources (short faint streaks, small blobs, thin bright lines) at 0.5-1.1x so pastes land in the 25-70 px band of the missed instances. Inclusion gets 28 (worst recall, most misses, still under the ~80 diminishing-return threshold); patches/scratches get 11 each to keep the shared detector fed. All constraints satisfied: 28+11+11=50, within headroom (79/93/93) and cumulative caps (54/23/23 <=105), scale spans 0.6 >=0.2, >=2 sources each.

plan.analysis: Previews match the misses well. Inclusion pastes are thin faint streaks (vertical + a couple horizontal) at small-to-medium size, consistent with the 33.6px missed median and the low-contrast look. Patches pastes are soft dark blobs on textured gray/white backgrounds, matching the 52.7px missed blobs. Scratches pastes are thin bright lines (mostly vertical, some horizontal) matching the 43.6px missed lines including the brighter high-contrast ones the model fails on. No unrealistic or wasted pastes; sizes sit in the 25-70px band rather than sub-learnable micro-pastes. Plan stands.
plan.rationale: Preview confirms appearance-matched, learnable-sized pastes for all three classes (faint streaks / soft blobs / thin bright lines), targeting the small low-tertile misses without dropping into unlearnable micro-scales. Inclusion keeps the largest share (28) as the worst class; patches/scratches 11 each keep the shared detector fed. Constraints hold: 28+11+11=50, within headroom and cumulative caps, scale span 0.6>=0.2, >=2 sources each.
